qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. What a nice dress! It really looks good on you. [G = I'm impressed.]
1. I still can't believe the price of that book I bought. I really didn't expect it to be so expensive.
2. Mark wasn't at school this morning. He's cutting classes again. What's wrong with him?
3. I am sorry but I can't stop crying. It is the best present ever!
4. I would be happy to go to the concert but I have to study for the exam. Please excuse me.
5. I was surprised by the offer and I still don't know how to decide between the two cars.
items: 1 — I can't believe the price of that book.
2 — Mark wasn't at school. What's wrong with him?
3 — I can't stop crying. The best present ever!
4 — I'd go to the concert but I have to study.
5 — I was surprised and don't know how to decide.

Which show are the tickets booked for?

"Dear Flora, Good news! I got the tickets. I tried to book the tickets for the ten o'clock show but it was sold out. You know that John can't leave the office before 8, so I managed to get three for the 9 o'clock show. Is that okay? Jack"

A The 8 o'clock show.
B The 9 o'clock show.
C The 10 o'clock show.

How does Rose feel about Frank's birthday?

"I want to make a cake for Frank's birthday but I've lost your recipe. His parents are going to be there and now I'm certain our relationship is serious. Scary, hah! I know I should be nervous about the whole thing but I can't wait for tomorrow."

A Nervous.
B Afraid.
C Excited.

Where is Mary going to meet her friend?

"Fancy meeting in town? I need to buy some groceries at the corner shop where we met last time. I'll be waiting for you with a cup of coffee at the new place next to Johnny's dry cleaner's, where I have to pick up my coat."

A At the grocer's.
B At the dry cleaner's.
C At the coffee shop.

What does Sybille think of her new mobile phone?

"My mum surprised me with a new mobile phone. It's not as light as my old one, but it looks much better. It has a bigger screen which makes everything easier. What's more, it was a real bargain."

A It's expensive.
B It's user-friendly.
C It's very light.

What would Mia like?

"You know it's my birthday soon. I guess I'll have to fake my surprise again when mum throws me a party. An intimate gathering of family members, as she calls it. If only she would invite my friends over too. That would spice up the evening. Wouldn't it be a blast!"

A A surprise party.
B An intimate party.
